Maya started roasting coffee in her garage in 2019. What began as a pandemic hobby
became an obsession — she left her engineering career, spent six months traveling
coffee farms in Colombia and Ethiopia, and came home with a vision.

Alex joined in 2022, bringing a background in French pastry and a firm belief
that a *great* croissant makes a great espresso even better.

Together, they opened **Ember & Bloom** on SE Division in the spring of 2024.
